stem: Arjun needs to establish the thesis of his paper. Which sentence should be added after sentence 4 to create an effective thesis statement?

options.label: F
options.text: James and Gastelum could not have imagined what a remarkable place the garden would one day become.

options.label: G
options.text: James’s home country of England did not offer the kind of climate that orchids need in order to grow outdoors.

options.label: H
options.text: Orchids come in all colors and sizes and are beloved by gardeners all over the world, even though they take some effort to grow.

options.label: J
options.text: Flowers would replace coffee as the crop grown on this large plantation.
